caption: The drawing shows a single metallic pitcher positioned upright on a plain, light background. The pitcher has a rounded body with a pronounced base and a narrow neck, which transitions into a flared spout. A large handle curves from the upper body to the neck of the pitcher. The lid of the pitcher is domed with a triangular finial on top. The color of the pitcher is depicted in shades of gray and black, giving the appearance of a metal, possibly pewter or silver. The drawing is centered on the page with ample blank space surrounding the object, and there is no other item or decoration in the scene. There is a small, red text or signature located slightly to the lower right of the pitcher.
title: Pewter Jar
